name: Process Step Option
description: One selectable outcome on a Choice step. This table is why the engine has no built-in Pass/Fail: Pass/Fail is simply two rows here, a three-tier check is three, and any other vocabulary (OK / Rework / Scrap) is authored the same way. `is_pass` drives scoring; `is_critical` drives quarantine.

fields.label: Value
fields.description: Stored value. Keep stable — run history refers to it.

fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown to the operator. Defaults to Value.

fields.label: Label (Alt Language)
fields.description: Hindi / regional rendering shown under the label.

fields.label: Counts as Pass
fields.description: Earns this step's weight when scoring.

fields.label: Critical
fields.description: Choosing this quarantines the run and fires On Critical actions.

fields.label: Requires Photo
fields.description: Ask for a photo when this option is chosen, regardless of the step's photo policy.

fields.label: Colour
fields.description: Never the only signal — the app always renders icon + word + colour.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Short glyph shown above the label, e.g. a tick or a cross.
